systems.system: Système intégré de gestion de l'information préfectorale (SIGIP): tracking of associations and administrative staff, statistics, messaging, forum and mapping of the circonscriptions
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Administration territoriale et de la Décentralisation
systems.tiers: prefectoral administration, as its name states; no tier of use given

note: Six locally built systems shown to the Prime Minister on 2025-09-16; the one in the study's field is the territorial administration ministry's prefectoral information system, a central-state system, and no local government office is said to use it or be connected.
